_header: THE FIRST HONEST READING. Produced by a real full-suite CI run (2,569 tests,
This replaces the placeholder that shipped in #151 ({floor: 0, uncovered: []}),
which could never fail: `len(uncovered) < 0` is unsatisfiable, so the ratchet
was arithmetically incapable of firing.
⛔ THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT A RUG. `floor` is the number of uncovered routes
measured on the run that produced it. A run finding FEWER than `floor` also
fails — the likeliest cause of 'zero offenders' is not that 21 routes acquired
tests, it is that the recorder stopped recording.
To legitimately cover a route: delete its entry AND lower `floor` by the same
amount, IN THE SAME COMMIT. Both edits are visible in review; a silent
improvement is not.
⛔ NEVER ADD AN ENTRY to buy a green build. A new uncovered route means a new
route shipped with no test. Write the test.
2026-09-05, second reading. Nine entries DELETED and floor lowered 21 -> 12 in
this same commit, per the rule above. Each was covered by a real test added in
the same PR, not by loosening the recorder: the six pm/llm tool routes are
exercised by tests/test_pm_tool_loaders_are_bounded.py, the three toc/compliance
routes by tests/test_toc_node_delete.py and
tests/test_compliance_check_applicability.py.
Same commit, one more: the architecture-element version-compare route is deleted and
floor lowered 12 -> 11. It was found by an adversarial review of the route_class blast
radius, not by the coverage gate: a route_class wraps all 16 routes on this router, and
5 of them had no post-fix request through them. Four were covered by suites that simply
were not being run; this one had no test anywhere -- 091f684:tests/test_coverage_boost.py compared
versions for /principles and /decisions but never for architecture elements.
Covered by tests/test_element_version_compare.py.
2026-09-05, THIRD reading -- THE FLOOR IS NOW ZERO. The remaining eleven are
deleted and floor lowered 11 -> 0, all in this commit. Exercising them found
three endpoints that accepted a parameter, never validated it, and answered
HTTP 200 with an empty result -- see
091f684:docs/incidents/2026-09-05-the-parameters-nobody-validated.md and the live BEFORE run in

at merge time, and is landed in a follow-up commit on main rather than claimed here.)

⚠ RECORDED SO THE NEXT SESSION DOES NOT RE-LITIGATE IT: the four
standards/views version routes have NO consumer. architecture_standards and
architecture_views both hold ZERO rows in production (measured 2026-09-05), the
fr frontend calls neither, and no demo touches them. Their tests therefore seed
their own data -- which proves the route parses and orders history correctly and
nothing more. That is deliberate, not an oversight.
⛔ FLOOR 0 IS THE STRICTEST SETTING, NOT A FINISHED STATE. With floor at 0 the
ratchet's lower half is inert (nothing can be fewer than zero), so from here the
gate only catches NEW uncovered routes. That is the intent. If a future run
reports uncovered > 0, a route shipped without a test -- write the test, do not
raise the floor.
